summary: iter87 — Frontend-only verification of the redesigned Strategy Detail (single Live/Off + single Edit Strategy) across WEB + MOBILE. CODE REVIEW: PASS on both surfaces — /app/frontend/src/pages/StrategyCenter.jsx L471-682 (StrategyDetail) shows exactly the new layout: (a) data-testid='strategy-live-toggle' with children data-testid='toggle-live' / 'toggle-off' beside the strategy name in top-right, (b) NO duplicate status badge in the detail hero (grade badge only), (c) ONE primary data-testid='edit-strategy-btn' opening StrategyConfigModal, (d) detail-metrics / detail-how-it-works / detail-best-used-in retained, (e) OLD testids (detail-regime-filter, detail-exit-params, detail-edit-parameters, detail-deploy-manage, detail-test-strategy) DELETED. Mobile counterpart /app/mobile/app/strategy/[id].tsx L23-160 mirrors exactly: testID='strategy-back' + title + testID='strategy-live-toggle' (with toggle-live/toggle-off) in top bar, single testID='edit-strategy-btn' opening StrategyConfigSheet, metrics + How It Works + Best Used In sections retained, NO duplicate on/off badge on hero card. Live/Off handlers on both surfaces call api.strategyProfileSave with {enabled, allowed_regimes (preserved), exit_method (preserved), exit_params (preserved)} — exit params & regimes are NOT wiped on toggle, matching the review spec. LIVE UI (web via browser automation): BLOCKED by two orthogonal issues detailed in action_items; got the Strategy Center loaded and library API returning 16 strategies (continuation, squeeze, ema-cross, hunter, supertrend, rsi-momentum, time-series-momentum, etc.), 6 PAPER-deployed, but couldn't reach the redesigned StrategyDetail via clicks because (1) library-card-ema-cross routes to the OLD CatalogDetail (internal:false in /api/library payload → CatalogDetail rendered — screenshot /tmp/w_ema_catalog_detail shows OLD 'Disable / Run Backtest / Test in Research Lab / Manage in Engine' action row + PAPER badge duplication), and (2) even for a wired card like continuation, clicking MANAGE toasted 'Owner login required to deploy' because AuthContext could not pick up the JWT from any of the localStorage keys I tried (ananta_token/token/auth_token/ananta_session) — the /api/auth/login POST itself returned 200 with a valid Bearer.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking a built-in strategy card in the library (e.g. library-card-ema-cross) navigates to CatalogDetail (OLD design with Disable/Run Backtest/Test in Research Lab/Manage-in-Engine action row and a duplicate PAPER status chip) — NOT the new StrategyDetail. The redesign is only reachable when s.internal===true, but /api/library returns internal:false for ema-cross/continuation/squeeze etc. so real users clicking these built-in strategies still see the OLD action-cluttered CatalogDetail. Reference: /app/frontend/src/pages/StrategyCenter.jsx L366 `s.internal ? onOpenInternal : onOpenCatalog` and L809 in CatalogDetail similarly only forwards if d.internal.

issues: Repeated finding from iter84/85/86 — the Coming Soon modal still gates every fresh session; no ?skipOnboarding=1 flag or persistence for owner-authed sessions. Automation still has to dismiss it every reload.

This is a real UX parity regression: mobile users get the redesigned page for ema-cross, web users still get the OLD clutter.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix Strategy Center routing on WEB so clicking a built-in strategy (ema-cross, continuation, squeeze, supertrend, hunter, rsi-momentum, time-series-momentum, etc.) lands on the NEW StrategyDetail — either (a) treat s.wireable && s.engine_key as sufficient to route via onOpenInternal (change /app/frontend/src/pages/StrategyCenter.jsx L366 to `(s.internal || (s.wireable && s.engine_key)) ? onOpenInternal(s.engine_key) : onOpenCatalog(s.id)`), OR (b) update CatalogDetail to render the new hero (Live/Off toggle + single Edit Strategy button) in place. Right now the redesign is invisible for the exact strategies (EMA Cross, etc.) the review request called out.

MEDIUM: Persist auth or add a URL flag to bypass the Coming Soon onboarding overlay for owner-authed sessions — repeated request from iter84/85/86. Also make the AuthContext token key well-known (readable via `localStorage.getItem` under one canonical key) so end-to-end automation can drop in a Bearer without going through the UI login dialog.

PARITY: Once web routing is fixed, verify that Live→Off→Live cycle persists allowed_regimes + exit_method + exit_params on WEB just like it does on MOBILE (code-review confirms both do this; live E2E was blocked by the above two issues).
critical_code_review_comments: The NEW StrategyDetail on WEB and NEW StrategyDetail on MOBILE are byte-for-byte equivalent in intent — same testids/testIDs (strategy-live-toggle, toggle-live, toggle-off, edit-strategy-btn), same preservation-on-toggle behavior for allowed_regimes/exit_method/exit_params, same removal of the duplicate on/off badge. Code review PASS on both.

The web routing gap (built-in strategies opening CatalogDetail instead of StrategyDetail) means end-users on WEB currently DO NOT see the redesign for the strategies the review request explicitly named (ema-cross etc.). This is a shipping blocker for the feature.

The Live/Off handler on both surfaces correctly forwards a full profile payload to PUT /api/strategy/{key}/profile (not just the enabled flag), which is what preserves regimes + exit params — matches the backend contract and iter85 pytest evidence.

rca of the issue: Root cause of the parity/UX gap: /app/frontend/src/pages/StrategyCenter.jsx L366 conditionally routes to StrategyDetail only when s.internal===true. The /api/library endpoint reports internal:false for the built-in engine strategies (ema-cross, continuation, squeeze, supertrend, hunter, rsi-momentum, time-series-momentum) even though they are wireable with valid engine_keys — so real users clicking these cards fall into CatalogDetail (old UI) and never reach the redesign. Reproduction: login as owner → Strategy tab → click 'EMA Cross' card → observe 'Disable / Run Backtest / Test in Research Lab / Manage in Engine' action row + duplicate 'PAPER' status chip; expected: strategy-live-toggle + edit-strategy-btn only. Mitigation: change L366 to `(s.internal || (s.wireable && s.engine_key)) ? onOpenInternal(s.engine_key) : onOpenCatalog(s.id)`, or update CatalogDetail hero to match the redesign.
